title: सूतपुत्र: जहाँ से अपमान शुरू हुआ
art_style: Phad (Rajasthan scroll painting): flat saturated vermilion/saffron/yellow, bold black outline, red border band
source: Mahabharata — Adi Parva (रंगभूमि), Shanti Parva (द्रोण से ब्रह्मास्त्र की माँग)
music_sfx: धीमा राजस्थानी रावणहत्था drone; "दरवाज़ा बंद" पर दरवाज़ा बंद होने की आवाज़; payoff पर भीड़ का शोर, फिर अचानक सन्नाटा
characters: Karna/Radheya (gold kavach + kundal, saffron dhoti, red angavastram)
Arjuna (white upper, yellow dhoti, blue angavastram)
frame: 1080x1920 (9:16), safe zone: top 220px + bottom 400px kept free of faces/text

shots.move: push-in fast (1.0→1.25) with lens flare sweep
shots.chars: Karna, centre frame, chest-up
shots.action: sun flares behind him; he lifts chin into the light
shots.expr: proud, calm; eyeline up-right to the sun
shots.light: sun directly behind (rim + flare), warm gold key from below-right; gold/saffron mood
shots.layers: FG: drifting embers | MG: Karna | BG: huge sun disc + rays
shots.vfx: sun rays rotating, bloom on armour, gold motes
shots.sfx: SFX: deep ravanhatha drone in + sun shimmer
shots.anim: 0-0.4s rays burst open; armour glint travels L→R (8 frames); chin lift 12 frames; continuous 6% push-in. Hook motion must start on frame 1.

shots.vo: पर दुनिया ने उसे बस एक नाम दिया: सूतपुत्र।
shots.chars: Karna centre; six accusing hands enter from all frame edges
shots.action: hands thrust in toward him; he lowers his eyes
shots.light: hard red side light from left, sun fading behind; mood turns from gold to blood-red
shots.layers: FG: pointing hands (blurred) | MG: Karna | BG: dark red void
shots.sfx: SFX: crowd murmur 'सूतपुत्र!' whisper layers, drum hit
shots.anim: hands slide in 10 frames each, staggered 3 frames; Karna eyes drop on the word 'सूतपुत्र' (6 frames); shake 3px.

shots.vo: सारथी अधिरथ के घर पला राधेय,
shots.chars: Young Radheya (boy) at screen-left by the river
shots.action: boy runs along the bank with a small bow
shots.props: small bow, chariot wheel leaning at the hut (charioteer family)
shots.light: soft dawn sun from right, warm peach haze
shots.layers: FG: reeds | MG: boy + hut | BG: river, hills, rising sun
shots.sfx: SFX: river flow, birds, soft drone
shots.anim: pan 120px over 2.5s; boy run cycle 8 frames/loop; reeds sway.

shots.vo: बचपन से सिर्फ़ एक सपना देखता था…
shots.chars: Radheya MG-left drawing bow; Radha BG-right watching from hut door
shots.expr: Radheya focused, tongue between lips; Radha smiling softly
shots.light: warm sun behind Radha (backlight), fill on boy's face
shots.layers: FG: boy + bow | MG: — | BG: Radha at doorway (soft focus)
shots.anim: string draw 18 frames; Radha smile + head tilt 12 frames; motes drift.

shots.move: track with arrow up-right toward sun
shots.chars: — (arrow only)
shots.action: arrow flies up toward the sun and becomes a gleam
shots.light: sun ahead, arrow silhouetted with gold rim
shots.layers: FG: arrow | BG: huge sun
shots.trans: match cut: arrow-gleam → sunlight on ashram (S06)
shots.anim: arrow travels 600px in 20 frames, trail 6 frames; flare blooms at end.

shots.vo: वो गुरु द्रोण के पास गया,
shots.chars: Karna (young man; kavach always visible — born with it) enters screen-left; Drona stands right, blessing a pupil
shots.light: bright morning sun top-left, dappled tree shade
shots.layers: FG: tree branch | MG: Karna walking, Drona | BG: hut, hills
shots.sfx: SFX: birds, footsteps on dry leaves
shots.anim: crane down 200px; walk cycle 12 frames; Drona's hand gesture loop.

shots.chars: Karna screen-left facing right, hands joined; Drona's shoulder FG-right
shots.light: soft key on Karna's face from right
shots.layers: FG: Drona shoulder/head (dark, soft) | MG: Karna | BG: ashram
shots.vfx: glowing Brahmastra idea: faint golden astra shape above Karna
shots.anim: Karna bow 15 frames; astra glow fades in/out 20 frames.

shots.chars: Drona, centre-right, profile turning away to screen-right
shots.light: light falls off: his face moves from light into shade
shots.layers: MG: Drona | BG: blurred hut
shots.anim: head turn 14 frames, eyes close 6 frames; hold 10 frames still.

shots.chars: Karna small in the gap of the closing ashram doors
shots.light: bright outside shrinking to a slit, inside dark
shots.layers: FG: door leaves | MG: Karna | BG: daylight
shots.anim: door leaves close over 12 frames, ease-in; 2-frame camera jolt on slam.

shots.vo: प्रतिभा थी, पर कुल नहीं था।
shots.chars: Karna centre, alone
shots.action: looks at his own hands / bow, sweat on brow
shots.light: harsh noon top light, split face light/shadow
shots.layers: MG: Karna | BG: bleached sky
shots.anim: push-in 5%; eyes lift from down to camera 16 frames; sweat drop slides 10 frames.

shots.chars: Karna small at centre, shooting at a tree target
shots.action: arrows pile up in the tree; shadow rotates
shots.props: bow, quiver, dozens of arrows in a tree trunk
shots.light: sun moving L→R, shadow sweeping
shots.layers: FG: grass | MG: Karna + target tree | BG: hills
shots.sfx: SFX: rapid arrow thunks layered, time ticking
shots.anim: time-lapse: sun travels 700px over 2.5s; arrows appear in tree 1 per 4 frames; Karna draw cycle 10 frames.

shots.chars: Karna silhouette, centre, bow raised toward the sun
shots.action: raises bow overhead as sun sets behind
shots.light: sun directly behind → full silhouette with gold rim
shots.layers: FG: dark grass | MG: Karna silhouette | BG: giant sun
shots.anim: crane up 150px; bow lift 20 frames; rays rotate slowly.

shots.vo: फिर हस्तिनापुर में राजकुमारों की परीक्षा हुई।
shots.move: crane down from banners to arena floor
shots.chars: crowds in the stands, princes as small figures in the arena
shots.light: bright high sun, warm festive palette
shots.layers: FG: banners | MG: crowd stands | BG: palace canopy
shots.anim: crowd bob loop 8 frames; banners flutter; crane 300px.

shots.chars: Arjuna screen-left facing right, drawing Gandiva
shots.action: releases; arrow splits a target far right
shots.light: sun top-right, crisp key on Arjuna
shots.layers: FG: dust | MG: Arjuna | BG: crowd blur
shots.anim: draw 12 frames, release 2 frames, arrow travel 10 frames.

shots.chars: Karna silhouette in the arena gate, golden armour shining
shots.action: steps through the gate into light
shots.light: strong backlight through gate; armour emits its own gold glow
shots.layers: FG: crowd heads turning | MG: Karna in gate | BG: bright outside
shots.vfx: golden flare, dust in light shafts
shots.anim: push-in 8%; step forward 16 frames; crowd heads turn 6 frames staggered.

shots.move: static, then quick push on stunned crowd
shots.chars: Karna screen-left facing right repeating the shot; Arjuna's split target re-split
shots.light: warm key from right; crowd in shade
shots.layers: FG: Karna | MG: arrow path | BG: frozen crowd
shots.vfx: arrow trail, petals hang in air
shots.sfx: SFX: twang, target crack, then SUDDEN SILENCE (crowd noise cuts)
shots.anim: release 2 frames; then everything holds still 12 frames (silence beat).

shots.vo: फिर उसने भरी सभा में अर्जुन को ललकारा…
shots.chars: Karna screen-left facing right; Arjuna screen-right facing left (keep this 180° line)
shots.action: Karna raises bow at Arjuna; Arjuna answers with his
shots.light: split lighting: gold on Karna, cool blue on Arjuna (sun vs Indra)
shots.layers: FG: dust | MG: both warriors | BG: crowd + darkening sky
shots.anim: both bows rise 14 frames; dust swirl loop; push-in 6%.

shots.vo: और तभी उससे एक सवाल पूछा गया,
shots.chars: Kripacharya steps in from screen-right between them, hand raised
shots.light: flat, still; music cut to silence
shots.layers: MG: Kripa | BG: frozen crowd
shots.sfx: SFX: SILENCE (1 s), one wind gust
shots.anim: only Kripa moves (hand rise 12 frames); everything else frozen.

shots.vo: जिसने उसकी पूरी ज़िंदगी बदल दी।
shots.move: very slow push-in; freeze frame at end
shots.chars: Karna's face filling frame
shots.action: eyes widen, breath catches; frame freezes
shots.light: light drains from gold to grey
shots.layers: MG: Karna face | BG: dark
shots.anim: eye widen 8 frames; then freeze + desaturate over 10 frames.

shots.chars: frozen face-off: Karna left, Kripa centre, Arjuna right
shots.light: darkened freeze, vignette
shots.layers: MG: three figures | BG: crowd
shots.anim: arrow bounces 3× (10 frames each); text pops in 6 frames.
